message: Follow-up: after posting the above comment, I decided to do some poking around on the web, and found a [neat extended critical essay](http://www.transparencynow.com/Logan/logan1.htm) on the movie that uses [Herbert](http://www.marxists.org/glossary/people/m/a.htm#marcuse-herbert) [Marcuse](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankfurt_School), Freud, and biblical metaphor to make some smart points. Some of the arguments are problematic, but it's worth a look.
